mapper.select: select from biz_stock_snapshot s where s.snapshot_date = #{snapshotDate} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_stock_snapshot (store_id, snapshot_date, book_kind, total_qty, qty_available, qty_locked, qty_borrowed, qty_damaged, total_amount, create_time) values (#{storeId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{bookKind}, #{totalQty}, #{qtyAvailable}, #{qtyLocked}, #{qtyBorrowed}, #{qtyDamaged}, #{totalAmount}, #{createTime}) on duplicate key update book_kind = values(book_kind), total_qty = values(total_qty), qty_available = values(qty_available), qty_locked = values(qty_locked), qty_borrowed = values(qty_borrowed), qty_damaged = values(qty_damaged), total_amount = values(total_amount), create_time = values(create_time)
